description: This file defines the Challenge class, implementing ChallengeInterface. It models a stateless challenge prompt mechanism with methods for retrieving modal titles, headings, subheadings, and validation prompt checks.

classes.name: Challenge
classes.description: Represents a stateless challenge prompt with dynamic titles, headings, and validation prompts based on the reason for the challenge.

methods.name: modalTitle
methods.description: Returns the modal title based on the challenge reason.

methods.name: heading
methods.description: Returns the heading in the modal, customized for the challenge reason or overridden with a provided heading.

methods.name: subheading
methods.description: Returns a subheading for the challenge, specific to migration challenges or undefined otherwise.

methods.name: hasPromptForValidationType
methods.description: Checks if the challenge prompts include a prompt matching a specific validation type.
